basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and Senior Backend Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and evolving enterprise systems and web applications.
Strong background in C#/.NET and Node.js, with a focus on software architecture, maintainable backend systems, clean code, refactoring, and API-driven development.
Experienced across the full SDLC in Agile/Scrum environments, contributing technical leadership through system design, code reviews, technical debt planning, developer mentoring, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with frontend and DevOps teams.

work.summary: Engineering software company delivering enterprise systems for gas network simulation, forecasting, monitoring, analysis, and operational data management.
highlights: Engineer backend systems for gas network simulation, consumption forecasting, and transmission-network monitoring across multiple projects for the National Iranian Gas Company.
Design and evolve C#/.NET services using Clean Architecture, CQRS, microservices, and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ.
Improve long-term maintainability through architectural redesign, code reviews, Clean Code practices, technical debt planning, and continuous refactoring.
Build GIS, data-ingestion, and reporting solutions using OGC standards, spatial services, web scraping, dynamic QueryBuilder-based reporting, and Excel automation.
Contribute across the SDLC through requirements analysis, system design, DevOps and frontend collaboration, developer mentoring, and team knowledge sharing.
Technologies: C# | .NET | ASP.NET Core | SQL Server | Clean Architecture | CQRS | Microservices | RabbitMQ | NestJS | Angular | GIS

work.summary: Software solutions company delivering business platforms, recruitment and search products, and mobile applications.
highlights: Designed and developed ParadiseHub, a NoSQL-based, multi-branch CRM and workspace-management platform supporting 11 user roles, rental plans, reservations, online payments, wallet transactions, financial reporting, and multi-stage application workflows.
Built advanced Elasticsearch query-building and search capabilities for large volumes of unstructured and filtered data.
Developed backend functionality for HR and recruitment platforms, including IranHR and a job-search engine, as well as data-related components for a mobile game.
Technologies: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MongoDB | Elasticsearch | REST APIs

work.summary: Intensive full-stack web development bootcamp focused on practical software engineering and product delivery.
highlights: Built a web-scraping pipeline that collected job postings from three major Iranian employment websites and powered a searchable job-search application.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and received an invitation to join FuTech Group as a Software Developer.
Technologies: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git

work.summary: Independent projects spanning embedded systems, control software, real-time monitoring, and software-hardware integration.
highlights: Developed control and monitoring software for interactive installations, radiation-monitoring equipment, access-control prototypes, silo-capacity monitoring, and automated parking-gate systems.
Worked across embedded programming, hardware communication, sensor integration, real-time monitoring, and software UI development using C, C#, AVR, Arduino, Windows Forms, and RS-232.
